title.en: Rome: expansion and the republic’s crisis
title.zh: 罗马：扩张与共和危机

location.label: Rome

summary.en: Rome’s republic combined magistrates, a senate and citizen assemblies, while struggles over status reshaped access to political power. Conquest and diplomacy created an extensive Mediterranean empire long before emperors ruled it. Provincial wealth enriched some Romans, but military demands and growing inequality intensified conflict. Civil wars and the dictatorship of Julius Caesar exposed the limits of republican institutions under these pressures. Octavian’s victory and his adoption of the title Augustus marked a new political settlement. The republic therefore illustrates how overseas expansion could transform the social foundations of government at home.
summary.zh: 罗马共和国结合官职、元老院与公民大会，身份斗争不断改变参与政治的资格。皇帝出现之前，征服与外交已经建立广阔的地中海帝国。行省财富使部分罗马人富裕，军事负担与不平等却加剧冲突。内战和凯撒独裁暴露共和制度面对这些压力的局限。屋大维胜利并获得奥古斯都称号后，形成新的政治安排；海外扩张也深刻改变了本土社会。

title.en: Heian Japan: writing a courtly world
title.zh: 平安日本：书写宫廷世界

location.label: Heiankyō / Kyoto

summary.en: The imperial court moved to Heiankyō and developed a culture closely associated with aristocratic households. The Fujiwara family exercised influence through marriage and regency, while poetry, diaries and narratives gave court life lasting literary form. Kana writing made new kinds of Japanese expression possible; The Tale of Genji is a celebrated example. Buddhist practice and continental connections remained important even as distinctive local artistic forms developed. By the late twelfth century, military families were challenging courtly political dominance. The period shows that a cultural capital can remain influential while practical political power shifts elsewhere.
summary.zh: 朝廷迁往平安京后，贵族家庭塑造了宫廷文化。藤原氏通过婚姻和摄政影响政局，诗歌、日记与物语保存了宫廷生活。假名使日语书写产生新的形式，《源氏物语》即为著名例证。佛教与大陆交流依旧重要，本土艺术也逐渐发展。十二世纪后期武家力量上升，说明文化中心可以持续有影响力，而实际政治权力已向别处转移。

title.en: Hull-House · Care, learning and an industrial neighborhood
title.zh: 赫尔之家 · 照护、学习与工业街区

location.label: Hull-House, Near West Side, Chicago; settlement and neighborhood context

summary.en:
Hull-House began in 1889 when Jane Addams and Ellen Gates Starr moved into a house at Halsted and Polk Streets on Chicago’s industrial west side. The settlement connected educated resident workers with a neighborhood shaped by immigration and industrial labor. It was one institution within a wider urban reform movement, rather than the beginning of all American settlement work.

The range of activities expanded beyond any single reformer. A kindergarten and day care supported working households; evening classes, arts, a library and clubs offered opportunities for learning and association. Job assistance and other services responded to the practical demands of earning a living. Raising money, recruiting residents and maintaining facilities were part of the institution’s work as much as its public ideals.

Investigation connected local conditions to policy debates. Addams and colleagues addressed sanitation, factory work, child welfare and women’s political participation. The settlement’s account of needs was itself a perspective: neighborhood residents were people with their own languages, work and priorities, not merely recipients of expert instruction.

The selected 1889–1915 interval follows the founding through Addams’s widening peace activism. It does not mark Hull-House’s closure or the end of neighborhood change. The site helps readers connect immigrant city life and social reform without treating a list of services as proof of equal access or lasting outcomes.
summary.zh:
1889年，简·亚当斯与艾伦·盖茨·斯塔尔搬入芝加哥工业西区哈尔斯特德街和波尔克街口的一所住宅，赫尔之家由此开始。定居服务机构把受教育的驻院工作人员与移民、工业劳动塑造的街区相连。它是更广泛城市改革运动中的机构，并非美国所有同类工作的起点。

活动范围超出任何一位改革者。幼儿园与日间托育支持劳动家庭；晚课、艺术、图书馆和俱乐部提供学习、交往机会。就业援助等服务回应谋生的实际要求。筹款、招募驻院人员与维护设施，与公开理想同样属于机构工作。

调查把地方条件与政策争论联系起来。亚当斯及同事关注卫生、工厂劳动、儿童福利与女性政治参与。服务机构对需要的描述本身也有视角：街区居民拥有自己的语言、工作和优先事项，并非仅仅接受专家指导的人。

1889—1915年的观察窗口从创办延伸至亚当斯扩大的和平行动，不表示赫尔之家关闭或街区变化终止。这个地点帮助读者连接移民城市生活与社会改革，而不把服务清单当作平等获取或长期成效的证明。

dateNote.en: Selected institutional focus 1889–1915, not the complete lifespan of Hull-House. The point is the settlement site at neighborhood scale; activities expanded into multiple facilities and cannot all be assigned to one room or opening year.

title.en: Deccan Buddhism: donors, monasteries and sacred landscapes
title.zh: 德干佛教：捐献者、寺院与神圣景观

location.label: Amaravati region; representative reference

summary.en:
Early Buddhist establishments in the Deccan grew within landscapes already associated with powerful trees, serpents and other sacred beings. Sculpture and architecture drew on these local visual traditions as communities created stupas, pilgrimage settings and places for teaching. Donations linked religious institutions to wider social networks, making a monument the outcome of many contributions rather than simply the command of a king.

Comparing this material with Sanchi and Ajanta reveals both shared religious purposes and regional choices. The survival of carved stone favors some kinds of evidence over others; it does not reveal every household’s beliefs or the full membership of a monastery. Reading images together with their settings helps explain how institutions took root while avoiding a story of one unchanged religious style spreading everywhere.
summary.zh:
德干早期佛教机构成长于树木、蛇神等已具有神圣意义的景观中。雕刻和建筑吸收这些视觉传统，形成佛塔、朝礼场所与讲学空间。捐献把宗教机构与更广的社会网络连接起来，使一处纪念建筑体现许多人的参与，而不只是国王的命令。

与桑奇、阿旃陀比较，可以同时观察共同的宗教目的和区域选择。石雕的保存偏重某些证据，并不能展示每个家庭的信仰或寺院全体成员。把图像放回具体环境，有助于解释机构如何扎根，而不把传播写成一种形式始终不变地覆盖各地。

dateNote.en: Focus follows the exhibition’s 200 BCE–400 CE framework; this is a network of institutions, not a political territory.
dateNote.zh: 关注时段采用展览的前200—400年框架；所述为机构网络，不是政治疆域。

title.en: Pachacuti · Reorganizing an expanding Inca state
title.zh: 帕查库蒂 · 重组扩张中的印加国家

location.label: Cusco; representative royal and administrative center

summary.en:
Pachacuti is associated with the transformation of Cusco’s rulers into an expanding imperial power during the fifteenth century. Political narratives connect his accession with conflict against the Chancas, while the reorganization of Cusco linked rule to a capital with sacred, administrative and productive functions. Expansion drew on conquest, alliances and the incorporation of existing local authorities.

The traditions about him were written down after the Spanish conquest and do not supply an uncontested modern-style life chronology. Conventional reign dates are therefore a reference for comparison, not proof of a precise annual frontier. His significance extends beyond military victories to the organization of a diverse Andean political world. The institutions attributed to imperial rule also depended on practices developed by earlier societies. Comparing his story with regional archaeology prevents a ruler’s biography from absorbing the history of every people incorporated into Tawantinsuyu.
summary.zh:
帕查库蒂与十五世纪库斯科统治者向帝国强权的转变有关。政治叙述把他即位同对昌卡人的冲突相连，库斯科重组则把统治同具有神圣、行政及生产功能的都城联系起来。扩张依赖征服、联盟及对既有地方权威的纳入。

关于他的传统在西班牙征服后才被写下，不能提供没有争议的现代式生平年表。传统统治年代因此是比较参照，而非精确逐年边界的证明。其重要性超出战功，也涉及组织多样的安第斯政治世界。帝国制度还依赖更早社会发展的实践。把个人故事同区域考古比较，可避免统治者传记吞没被纳入塔万廷苏尤的各族历史。

dateNote.en: Working reign focus c.1438–1471 follows the British Museum; other surveys extend to c.1473. These are not birth/death dates.

title.en: Across the Sahara: exchange, scholarship and coercion
title.zh: 横越撒哈拉：交换、学术与强制

location.label: Western Sahara/Sahel corridor; schematic regional reference

summary.en:
Trans-Saharan exchange connected communities on both sides of the desert through routes that depended on knowledge of water, seasons and local political conditions. Gold, salt and other goods moved through networks of producers, carriers and merchants. The prosperity of Sahelian courts was one result, but the story also includes the labour of supplying caravans and the power of communities controlling stages of a journey.

Religious learning, texts and artistic forms circulated with people and commerce. Enslavement and forced movement were also part of these networks and must remain visible beside accounts of wealth and cosmopolitanism. Ghana/Wagadu, Mali, Songhai and Kanem–Borno occupied different regions and periods; their participation does not make the entire Sahara one trading state. The map point marks a broad corridor for comparison, not a verified stop, a direct documented route or a permanent road across an otherwise empty desert.
summary.zh:
跨撒哈拉交换通过依赖水源、季节与地方政治知识的路线，连接沙漠两侧社区。黄金、盐及其他物品经生产者、运输者与商人的网络流动。萨赫勒宫廷的繁荣是结果之一，故事也包括供应商队所需的劳动，以及控制途中节点的社区权力。

宗教学问、文本与艺术形式随人口和商业一起流传。奴役和强迫迁移同样属于这些网络，不能被财富与多元交流的叙述遮蔽。瓦加杜／加纳、马里、桑海及卡涅姆—博尔诺分属不同区域与时期；参与贸易不意味着整个撒哈拉是一国。本图点位标记用于比较的宽泛走廊，不是已核实停靠点、直接文献路线，或穿越“空旷”沙漠的永久道路。

title.en: Valley Forge · Supply systems and a camp society
title.zh: 福吉谷 · 补给体系与营地社会

location.label: Valley Forge, Pennsylvania; representative winter encampment area

summary.en:
The Continental Army’s winter at Valley Forge joined military survival to the work of a temporary community. From December 1777 to June 1778, soldiers built huts, guarded approaches and obtained food, clothing and equipment near British-occupied Philadelphia. A bridge over the Schuylkill connected the camp with farms, a market and commissary activity north of the river. Supply was an organizational problem, rather than simply an absence of food everywhere nearby.

Women and children lived with the army, alongside free and enslaved Black people, Indigenous allies, immigrants and men with different reasons for serving. Their experiences were unequal. Some sought wages or freedom, while others had been conscripted. Local residents also disagreed about the war; assistance, refusal, requisition and accusations of disloyalty shaped their encounters with soldiers.

Disease caused much of the mortality, including in spring when provisions improved. Care, sanitation and organization mattered alongside the better-known military training associated with Friedrich Wilhelm von Steuben. Keeping the army in one place also consumed timber, fences, livestock and stores from surrounding communities.

The camp’s transformation was therefore collective and costly. Its history is distinct from a battle narrative: no battle occurred at Valley Forge, and the 1777–1778 interval does not imply that everyone there shared one meaning of liberty.
summary.zh:
大陆军在福吉谷过冬，把军事生存与临时社区的劳动结合起来。1777年12月至1778年6月，士兵在英军占领的费城附近建造木屋、守卫通道，并获取食物、衣物和装备。跨越斯库尔基尔河的桥梁，把营地与北岸农场、市场及军需活动相连。补给首先是组织问题，并不只是周边处处缺粮。

妇女和儿童与军队同住，营地还有自由及被奴役的黑人、原住民盟友、移民，以及出于不同动机服役的人。他们的处境并不平等。有些人谋求工资或自由，另一些则被征召。当地居民对战争也有分歧；援助、拒绝、征用及“不忠”的指控，影响他们与士兵的关系。

疾病造成大量死亡，甚至在春季补给改善后仍然如此。照护、卫生和组织，与冯·施托伊本的军事训练同样重要。大军集中驻扎，还消耗周边社区的木材、围栏、牲畜与储粮。

因此，营地的转变既是集体成果，也付出社会成本。它与战役叙述不同：福吉谷没有发生战斗，1777—1778年的窗口也不意味着所有人对自由有共同理解。

dateNote.en: 19 December 1777–19 June 1778 is the encampment interval. The point marks the camp area, not every hut, hospital, supply farm or resident’s address. Surrounding land use and community histories began earlier and continued afterward.

title.en: Seitō · A collective makes a literary public
title.zh: 《青鞜》 · 集体出版与文学公共空间

location.label: Tokyo; representative educational and editorial setting

summary.en:
Seitō’s first issue appeared on 1 September 1911. The women who edited and published it included Hiratsuka Raichō, Yasumochi Yoshiko, Mozume Kazuko, Kiuchi Teiko and Nakano Hatsuko. Treating the magazine as a collective makes visible the work behind a manifesto: selecting writing, assembling issues and creating a readership for women’s words.

Literary work became a means of discussing social authority. The magazine broadened its attention to relationships, sexuality and women’s autonomy, while translations brought writers from outside Japan into local debate. These connections did not erase differences among contributors or turn the magazine into the voice of every Japanese woman. Access depended on literacy, circulation and the ability to withstand public criticism.

Schools prohibited reading it, and authorities seized some issues as threats to public morals. Those responses show how the regulation of print could constrain a new discussion space. The selected early-years window is editorial, rather than a claim that the journal closed in 1915. This record follows the production and reception of a publication alongside Hiratsuka’s life, inviting comparison with education and other women’s writing already represented in the atlas.
summary.zh:
《青鞜》创刊号于1911年9月1日出版。参与编辑和发行的女性包括平塚雷鸟、保持研子、物集和子、木内锭子与中野初子。把杂志视为集体事业，就能看到宣言背后的工作：选择作品、编排期刊，并为女性文字建立读者群。

文学由此成为讨论社会权威的途径。杂志逐渐关注亲密关系、性及女性自主，通过翻译把日本以外的作者引入本地讨论。这些联系并未消除作者之间的分歧，也不使杂志自动成为所有日本女性的声音。阅读机会取决于识字、流通及承受社会批评的能力。

一些学校禁止学生阅读，当局也以有碍公共道德为由没收部分期刊。这些反应显示，出版管制会约束新出现的讨论空间。所选早期年份是编辑观察窗口，并非声称杂志于1915年停刊。本条将出版物的制作与接受过程同平塚的生平并读，并与图谱已有的教育及女性写作条目进行比较。

dateNote.en: 1911–1915 is a selected early-years focus, not the complete publication lifespan or an exact closure date. The inspected library account supports themes and reception; individual seized issues were not independently collated.

title.en: The Cherokee Phoenix · A nation speaks in print
title.zh: 《切罗基凤凰报》 · 一个民族的印刷声音

location.label: New Echota, Georgia; historical newspaper publication center

summary.en:
The Cherokee Nation began publishing the Cherokee Phoenix at New Echota in February 1828. Its pages placed Cherokee syllabary and English text within the same newspaper, bringing written Cherokee into a recurring public forum. This was an institution of a living nation debating education, government and its future while the United States and Georgia pressed for removal.

The paper covered national government, community and religious activities, relations with other Indigenous peoples, and arguments over land. Congressional debates and court decisions appeared beside subjects closer to everyday life. Reading these materials shows that resistance was also sustained through information, editorial judgment and communication among readers.

The original newspaper ceased publication in 1834, before the forced removal of 1838. Its surviving run therefore cannot provide eyewitness reporting of that later event. Western Carolina University’s digital project transcribes selected English-language articles concerning Cherokee and regional history; it does not reproduce the whole bilingual paper. The distinction matters: a searchable modern archive offers an entry into this political world while preserving only part of what its historical readers encountered.
summary.zh:
切罗基民族于1828年2月在新埃科塔出版《切罗基凤凰报》。报纸把切罗基音节文字与英语放在同一公共版面，使书面切罗基语进入持续性的讨论空间。当美国政府与佐治亚州推动强迁时，这一仍然存续的民族正通过报刊讨论教育、治理与自身前途。

报纸报道民族政府、社区及宗教活动，与其他原住民族的关系，以及有关土地的争论。国会辩论和法院判决，同更贴近日常生活的题材并列。这些材料显示，抵抗也通过信息、编辑判断及读者之间的沟通持续展开。

原报于1834年停刊，早于1838年的强制迁移，因此不能将存世报刊当成对后来事件的现场报道。西卡罗来纳大学的数字项目转录了涉及切罗基及地区历史的部分英语文章，并未重现完整双语报纸。这个区别很重要：可检索的现代档案让人进入当时的政治世界，却只保留了历史读者所见内容的一部分。

title.zh: 雅典公民大会：参与及其界限

location.label: Athens, Pnyx area; representative assembly setting, not a territorial boundary

summary.en:
In classical Athens, the assembly made decisions about war, peace, alliances and public policy. Its participants were adult male citizens. Women, resident foreigners and enslaved people were outside this political body, although all formed part of the society in which it operated. A citizenship rule introduced in 451 BCE required citizen parentage on both sides.

Formal eligibility also differed from practical attendance. Someone living far from the city faced a different journey to a meeting from a nearby resident. The assembly therefore offers a concrete way to examine political participation: who could speak and vote, which decisions were shared, and whose labour and lives remained beyond the franchise. The map point marks the Pnyx area, a civic meeting setting. The selected half-century is a reading focus, not a claim that the institution began in 450 BCE or ended in 400 BCE.
summary.zh:
古典时期的雅典公民大会决定战争、和平、联盟及公共事务。参加者是成年男性公民。妇女、外来定居者和被奴役者被排除在这一政治机构之外，尽管他们都是雅典社会的一部分。公元前451年的公民资格规定要求父母双方均具有公民身份。

法律上的资格也不等于实际到场的机会。住在远处的居民与城市附近的居民，参加会议所需的路程并不相同。因此，公民大会提供了考察政治参与的具体切入点：谁可以发言和表决，哪些决定由集体作出，谁的劳动与生活处在选举权之外。地图标示普尼克斯山附近的公共集会环境。所选半世纪是阅读范围，不表示该制度始于前450年或终于前400年。

dateNote.en: Selected focus: c.450–400 BCE; institutional practices changed before and after this interval.

title.en: Martin Luther King Jr. · Churches, collective action and economic justice
title.zh: 小马丁·路德·金 · 教会、集体行动与经济正义

location.label: Atlanta, Georgia; Ebenezer Baptist Church and organizing context

summary.en:
Martin Luther King Jr. developed his public voice through education, Baptist ministry and organized struggle against segregation. Study at Morehouse, Crozer and Boston University preceded his 1954 pastorate at Dexter Avenue Baptist Church in Montgomery. When the city’s Black residents began their bus boycott in 1955, he became a leading spokesman within a campaign sustained by many organizers, churches, workers and households.

The boycott exposed him and his family to arrest, bombing and intimidation. His subsequent leadership in the Southern Christian Leadership Conference helped connect local campaigns, drawing on Christian argument and nonviolent action. From 1960 he also served as co-pastor at Atlanta’s Ebenezer Baptist Church. A church was a workplace and organizing institution, not only the setting for memorable speeches.

The Nobel Peace Prize in 1964 recognized his movement leadership, but recognition did not complete the struggle. In 1968 Memphis sanitation workers demanded union recognition, safer equipment and adequate wages after two colleagues were killed. Their campaign had its own local leaders and a history preceding King’s arrival. He joined because racial equality and economic justice could not be separated.

The March protest he helped lead ended in violence, and police attacked demonstrators; he nevertheless returned to support continued nonviolent organizing. He was assassinated at the Lorraine Motel on 4 April. Workers and supporters continued afterward, reaching an agreement later that month. His life story therefore points outward to the institutions and collective labor that made action possible, rather than making one speaker responsible for every civil-rights achievement.
summary.zh:
小马丁·路德·金通过教育、浸信会牧职及反对种族隔离的组织行动，形成公共表达。在莫尔豪斯学院、克罗泽神学院与波士顿大学学习后，他1954年到蒙哥马利德克斯特大道浸信会教堂任牧师。1955年当地黑人居民开始抵制公共汽车时，他成为重要发言人；运动依靠众多组织者、教会、工人和家庭维持。

抵制使他及家人遭遇逮捕、炸弹袭击与恐吓。此后他领导南方基督教领袖会议，以基督教论述和非暴力行动连接地方运动。自1960年起，他还在亚特兰大埃比尼泽浸信会教堂担任共同牧师。教会是工作与组织机构，不只是著名演讲的背景。

1964年诺贝尔和平奖认可其运动领导作用，但获奖并未完成斗争。1968年，两位同事遇难后，孟菲斯清洁工要求工会承认、较安全的设备和足够工资。当地运动有自己的领袖和早于金到访的历史。他参与是因为种族平等与经济正义无法分开。

他协助领导的3月示威以暴力告终，警察袭击参加者；他仍返回支持继续的非暴力组织。4月4日，他在洛林汽车旅馆遇刺。工人和支持者随后继续行动，在当月晚些时候达成协议。其生平因此把目光引向使行动成为可能的制度与集体劳动，而不把所有民权成果归于一位演说者。

title.en: Timbuktu manuscripts · Law, livelihood and learning
title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿 · 法律、生计与学习

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Manuscripts preserved in libraries around Timbuktu reveal scholarship concerned with everyday obligations as well as theology. The Library of Congress exhibition describes texts on inheritance, commercial contracts, arithmetic and the social value of labour. Poems could help students remember rules; commentaries and examples allowed knowledge to be taught and debated.

The same collections also preserve the unequal institutions within which learning operated. Commercial agreements concern the trafficking of enslaved people, and an emancipation certificate records a woman being granted freedom. Ahmad Baba’s legal opinion limited permissible enslavement within Islamic law without rejecting the institution altogether. Intellectual achievement and coercive social relations therefore belong in the same history.

The selected seventeenth-to-nineteenth-century focus connects Baba’s writing to later manuscript copies, including objects catalogued as copied in 1733, 1809 and 1858. A copy date does not date the invention of its subject or every earlier version. This is a study of described surviving texts, not a new translation of their Arabic pages or a claim that legal prescriptions show how every household actually behaved.
summary.zh:
廷巴克图周边图书馆保存的手稿，显示学术既关乎神学，也关乎日常义务。美国国会图书馆展览介绍了继承、商业契约、算术及劳动社会价值的文本。诗歌可帮助学生记忆规则；注释与例题使知识能够教学和讨论。

同一批收藏也保存了学术活动所在社会的不平等制度。商业契约涉及贩运被奴役者，解放证书记载一名女性获释。艾哈迈德·巴巴的法律意见在伊斯兰法内限制可许可的奴役，却未全面否定该制度。因此，思想成就和强制性的社会关系属于同一段历史。

本条所选十七至十九世纪窗口，把巴巴著述与后来的手稿抄本相连，其中有目录注明抄于1733、1809和1858年的实物。抄写日期不是知识主题的发明年，也不是所有更早版本的年代。本条研究的是传世文本的已读解说，不是重新翻译阿拉伯语页面，也不声称法律规范证明每个家庭实际如何生活。

title.en: Sukhothai: connected towns and political institutions
title.zh: 素可泰：相连的城镇与政治制度

location.label: Sukhothai; representative capital location

summary.en:
Sukhothai’s political landscape included related towns rather than one isolated capital. Waterworks, roads, religious establishments and production sites linked urban centers with their hinterlands. Archaeological evidence of ceramics also places this landscape within wider exchange networks.

Royal inscriptions and monuments express claims about authority and religious patronage, but those claims need comparison with the material record. A later national origin story is not identical to the experience of every community living in the region. The political focus here complements the existing art-and-city entry: it asks how infrastructure and institutional relationships helped sustain a kingdom. Broad century dates are used because the evidence summarized here does not justify assigning uniform administrative control to every year and location.
summary.zh:
素可泰的政治景观包含相互关联的城镇，而非孤立首都。水利、道路、宗教机构及生产场所把城市中心同腹地连接起来；陶瓷考古证据又使其进入更广泛的交换网络。

王室铭文和纪念建筑表达权威与宗教资助诉求，但需要同物质遗存比较。后来的民族起源叙事，不等于当地每个社区的经验。本条政治重点补充已有艺术与城市记录，追问基础设施和制度关系如何维持王国。这里使用世纪范围，因为所概括证据不足以为每一年、每一处地点赋予同样行政控制。

interpretation.zh: 这尊铜像从实物尺度呈现条目讨论的宗教艺术，与素可泰景观中的大型寺庙形成补充。

asset.creator: Unrecorded Thai bronze caster

note.en: The object page marks the image Public Domain and the API returns isPublicDomain: true. Met Open Access releases it under CC0. Collection credit: Purchase, Lita Annenberg Hazen Charitable Trust Gift, 1985
note.zh: 馆藏页将图像标为公有领域，API亦确认公有领域状态；大都会开放获取政策以CC0发布。入藏署名见馆藏记录。

transformation.en: Museum-provided web-large JPEG preserved byte-for-byte. No local crop, resize, recolouring or image generation.
transformation.zh: 逐字节保存博物馆提供的web-large JPEG，未在本地裁剪、缩放、调色或生成内容。

asset.retrieval: Official object API, collection page and Open Access policy inspected. Delivery JPEG decoded, hashed and pixels reviewed; receipts and entry-level decisions retained in world-batch-04.
